page_title: MNU 0-3 BOU | Manchester Utd v Bournemouth 09/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+4' Celebrations are cut short for Bournemouth as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
90+2' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was a handball in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Bournemouth players aren’t happy.
90+2' Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 0:4.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' It's time for a substitution. Joe Rothwell (Bournemouth) comes on in place of Lewis Cook.
88' Here is a change. Marcus Tavernier is going off and Andoni Iraola gives the last tactical orders to Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth).
87' Manchester Utd fail to score from a corner as Neto (Bournemouth) leaps to collect the ball.

86' Manchester Utd can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
84' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Peter Bankes had an easy-decision to make.
79' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Alejandro Garnacho as he is replaced by Marcus Rashford (Manchester United).
79' Erik ten Hag has decided to make a change. Facundo Pellistri (Manchester United) replaces Antony.
79' Substitution. Jonny Evans (Manchester United) replaces Luke Shaw.
76' That's unlucky! Scott McTominay (Manchester United) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.

73' 0 - 3 Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet a cross the corner kick and scores with a great header into the top right corner. The goalkeeper had no chance to react. The score is now 0:3.
73' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) prepares to take a corner kick.
73' The resulting corner from Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger. The ball goes out of play. Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.
72' It will be a substitution. Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) is ready to enter the pitch as Justin Kluivert walks off.
68' 0 - 2 Philip Billing (Bournemouth) rises highest and produces a brilliant header that sails into the roof of the net after beating the goalkeeper!
68' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
65' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
65' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
62' The linesman raises his flag. Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) is adjudged offside.
60' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
60' Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) was too forceful with his tackle and Peter Bankes interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
58' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. Antoine Semenyo is replaced by Philip Billing (Bournemouth).
57' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar.
57' Sergio Reguilon (Manchester United) is about to take a corner kick.
57' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. It will be a corner kick for Manchester Utd.
57' Antony (Manchester United) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
56' The game has come to an end for Anthony Martial. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United).

56' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The ball goes behind for a corner. Manchester Utd will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
50' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Manchester Utd comes to nothing.
50' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Corner kick. Manchester Utd will have an opportunity.
50' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner which is cleared.
50' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. Manchester Utd force a corner. They send men into the box.

50' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Scott McTominay (Manchester United) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
49' The corner is swung in but Manchester Utd can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

49' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) picks up the ball and goes on a great solo run. He decides to shoot from mid-range but his attempt is comfortably blocked by a defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Manchester Utd will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
41' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
40' What a chance that is! Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the left post!
38' Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!

36' That didn't go as planned! Anthony Martial (Manchester United) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Neto, who easily kept it out.
34' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
30' Sergio Reguilon (Manchester United) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
29' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) wins the battle with the defender and plants a header goalwards from the corner, but his effort from around the penalty spot sails harmlessly past the right post.
28' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
28' Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. The ball is out of play. Bournemouth will have a chance to score from a corner.
28' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) will take the corner.
27' This is a yellow card! Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
26' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
24' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) has a goal ruled out for offside!
19' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Peter Bankes has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
16' A great solo run by Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort low towards the middle of the goal was easily caught by Andre Onana.
14' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

13' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Good work from Manchester Utd as they win a corner.
12' Antony (Manchester United) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul.
9' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Manchester Utd.

9' Neto pulls off a fantastic save! Harry Maguire (Manchester United) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the top of the net, but the effort is kept out. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Manchester Utd.
8' A dangerous looking corner kick from Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is cleared to safety by the defence.

8' Sergio Reguilon (Manchester United) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play. Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.

5' 0 - 1 Goal! Lewis Cook displays great vision and sends a pass to Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom left corner. The score is 0:1.
3' Sergio Reguilon (Manchester United) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
3' Sergio Reguilon (Manchester United) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Bournemouth will take the kick-off.
Peter Bankes will supervise the game today.
